serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled labour minutes available in the bucket; bookedMin is the bucket's authoritative booked load; ledgerBookedMin is the service_capacities reserved figure, kept only so its lag stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so the two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series - the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity, not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, not a ceiling of zero.
